title: Depth-one circuit characterizations
statement: For every Boolean language $L$, recognition by a family of Boolean circuit trees with fan-in at most two, polynomial size, and depth at most $b( loor{	ext{?}})$—more precisely, depth at most $b(\log_2 n+1)$ for all input lengths $n$, for some natural number $b$—is equivalent to recognition by a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two, polynomial size, and depth at most $b(\log_2 n+1)$ for all $n$, for some natural number $b$.
caveat: The depth bound uses the natural-number logarithm $\mathrm{Nat.log}\,2\,n$, not the real logarithm; the statement’s displayed bound is rendered with this convention.
